# #5217: Patch: follow-up to #5213 from the after-merge spot-check
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

<!-- jackioh-bot:spot-check-follow-up #5213 -->
The after-merge spot-check of #5213 ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/46083857679)) found 2 blocking problem(s) in the change as it merged (`6190f42276b2`). `claude-4` (claude, `opus`, strong) reviewed it. #5213 stays merged: nothing is reverted, and this issue fixes what it found in a change of its own, from `main`.

## What to fix

- [ ] `apps/web/src/audio/voice-lines.test.ts:545`: The R655 dead-effect test now permanently exempts all 47 verb-bank names and never expires, which breaks CLAUDE.md rule 15 ('a suppression says why and expires … fails once it suppresses nothing'), and the test said to guard the exemption cannot fail.
  Evidence: The filter is `!used.has(name) && !VERB_BANK_EFFECTS.has(name)`. Nothing fails when a card starts naming an exempt effect, so after #5187 names most of them, any that stay unused (lightningWind/Release/Tail, which the PR's own census says no card calls) stay silently exempt for good. The guard, verbBank.test.ts '#5190 exempts no bank effect that a row does not use', builds `used` from VERB_ROWS exactly the way test/verbBank.ts builds VERB_BANK_EFFECTS (`Object.values(VERB_ROWS).flatMap(row => [row.windUp, row.release, row.tail])`), so both assertions are tautologies. The PR says this test 'fails if the exemption holds a name no row uses', but it cannot. Fix: keep the exemption as its own explicit list, separate from the verb-table data, and have a test fail when a card's hook names any listed effect, so the list only shrinks.
- [ ] `apps/web/src/audio/verbBank.test.ts:43`: The test '#5190 names the verb effects for what they sound like, never a card' can never fail. It also skips the catalog-card-name check the plan asked for.
  Evidence: It runs `name.toLowerCase().includes(id)` over `Object.keys(CARD_AUDIO.cards)`. Those ids are hyphenated (`"core-001"`, card-audio.json5:270), and every verb effect name is a bare camelCase identifier, so no name can contain one. Its second assertion (`names` contains `verbNames`) only repeats the row test above it. The plan (Tests, verbBank.test.ts) asked it to check catalog card names as well; the PR admits it does not ('Weak check'). Fix: compare each verb effect name against the catalog's card names, normalised to lowercase alphanumerics (currentCatalog or the catalog JSON the web already reads), and drop the id comparison.

## Done when

- Each finding above is fixed where it points, or answered with the evidence that it does not hold.
- Every check is green, with no test skipped, ignored or weakened to get there (CLAUDE.md rule 12).

None. The issue says "47" names, but the bank holds 48 (24 per-element, 5 winds, 3 tails, 16 releases), so the plan lists 48 and asserts no count.
